apps.subtitle: On-device iOS app signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription: RyukSign is an on-device app signer and installer for iOS, derived from Feather (by claration). Sign and install apps with a .p12 / .mobileprovision pair, manage tweaks (.dylib/.deb/.framework/.bundle/.appex), transfer files over HTTP/WebDAV, and track app updates — entirely on-device.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new in 4.1.0

### New

- Added Update All to Sources updates with search, a source picker for each app, and a choice to add, sign, or sign and install
- Added long press actions to grouped updates, including Ignore Updates
- Added a Versions to Delete option to Automatic Cleanup to also remove same or newer copies after installing
- Added your Library's identifiers for the same app to the Identifier editor when signing

### Improvements

- Improved updates to keep the bundle identifier of your installed or signed copy, so they replace it instead of installing a second app

### Fixes

- Fixed apps missing their provisioning profile after signing and Remove Provisioning not working
- Fixed large apps timing out or showing Failed while still installing
- Fixed installs getting stuck halfway
- Fixed tiny apps showing Failed after installing
- Fixed the wrong app icon showing in Sources updates after another app finished updating
- Fixed a black screen when using View in Sources from an update's source list


## Install

- Download **RyukSign.ipa** from the assets below and sign it, or
- Add the RyukSign source to get updates in the app: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/faroukbmiled/RyukSign/main/app-repo.json`

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/faroukbmiled/RyukSign/compare/v4.0.0...v4.1.0
